payload.name: Nash Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pier39 enables a new kind of shopping experience: agent-to-agent commerce.

Instead of manually browsing stores and negotiating with sellers, users can describe what they want and their budget. Pier39 discovers participating negotiate.v1 merchants, finds matching products, opens negotiations with merchant AI sales agents, and works toward the best possible deal on the user's behalf.

The app can:

• Search across participating stores for products matching user intent
• Discover product catalogs and pricing automatically
• Negotiate discounts, bundles, shipping, warranties, and other concessions
• Compare offers across multiple merchants
• Summarize negotiated outcomes and savings opportunities
• Help users make more informed purchasing decisions

Pier39 is built on the negotiate.v1 protocol, an open standard that allows AI shopper agents and AI merchant agents to negotiate without prior integration or coordination.
payload.longDescription:
Pier39 带来一种全新的购物体验：代理对代理商业。

用户无需手动浏览商店并与卖家议价，只需描述想要的商品和预算。Pier39 会发现参与的 negotiate.v1 商家，找到符合条件的商品，与商家的 AI 销售代理展开谈判，并代表用户争取尽可能划算的交易。

该应用可以：

• 在参与的商店中搜索符合用户需求的商品
• 自动发现商品目录和定价
• 协商折扣、套装、运费、保修和其他优惠
• 比较多家商户的报价
• 总结谈判结果和潜在节省金额
• 帮助用户做出更明智的购买决定

Pier39 基于 negotiate.v1 协议构建。这是一项开放标准，允许 AI 购物代理与 AI 商户代理在无需预先集成或协调的情况下进行谈判。

payload.name: Home Connect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Home Connect for ChatGPT helps you control your home appliances from Bosch, Siemens, NEFF, Gaggenau, and our other brands in a simple and convenient way.

Get the most out of your smart home appliances. Home Connect allows you to manage your household in a whole new way. Whenever you want, from wherever you are.

- Control and monitor your kitchen and home appliances
- Easier use of appliances – start & stop, select quick or silent options
payload.longDescription:
Home Connect for ChatGPT 可让你以简单便捷的方式控制 Bosch、Siemens、NEFF、Gaggenau 及其他品牌的家用电器。

充分发挥智能家电的优势。Home Connect 让你以全新方式管理家务，无论何时何地都可以使用。

- 控制并监控厨房和家用电器
- 更轻松地使用电器——启动和停止设备，选择快速或静音选项

payload.name: Courtroom5
payload.description: 覆盖 50 个州的民事法律帮助
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Courtroom5 serves self-represented litigants (SRLs) — people who must navigate civil court without an attorney, typically because they cannot afford one. Roughly 80% of civil litigants in the United States appear without legal representation. Without guidance, they lose cases on procedural technicalities before the merits are ever heard.

The Courtroom5 app gives ChatGPT users access to three jurisdiction-aware legal tools: a case intake assessment that evaluates a user's situation and identifies applicable civil claims; a deadline calculator that returns precise procedural deadlines and consequences by state and court level; and next-step guidance for users already in active litigation. All tools are scoped to civil matters in US state and federal courts and designed for plain-language delivery to non-lawyers.

Courtroom5 is a Techstars graduate and recipient of the ABA Woman of Legal Tech recognition. We have served over 12,000 self-represented litigants across all 50 states.
payload.longDescription:
Courtroom5 服务于自行代理的诉讼当事人（SRL）——他们通常因无力承担律师费用而不得不在没有律师的情况下应对民事诉讼。美国大约 80% 的民事诉讼当事人没有法律代理。缺乏指导时，他们往往在案件实体问题得到审理前，就因程序性细节而败诉。

Courtroom5 应用为 ChatGPT 用户提供三种了解司法管辖区的法律工具：评估用户情况并识别适用民事诉求的案件受理评估；按州和法院级别提供精确程序期限及其后果的截止日期计算器；以及为已进入诉讼程序的用户提供后续步骤指导。所有工具仅适用于美国州法院和联邦法院的民事案件，并以通俗易懂的语言面向非律师设计。

Courtroom5 是 Techstars 毕业企业，并获得 ABA Woman of Legal Tech 认可。我们已在全部 50 个州为超过 12,000 名自行代理的诉讼当事人提供服务。

payload.name: OTOMOTO
payload.description: 在 OTOMOTO 找到心仪的汽车
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Znajdź samochód marzeń w OTOMOTO, używając prostego języka. Zapomnij o skomplikowanych filtrach i formularzach wyszukiwania. Wystarczy, że opiszesz na OTOMOTO, czego szukasz, np. „SUV z niskim przebiegiem, idealny dla 4-osobowej rodziny" albo „młody rocznik, auto miejskie".
Kluczowe funkcje:

Inteligentne wyszukiwanie – opisz wymarzone auto prostym językiem
Trafne wyniki – uzyskaj informacje o każdym ogłoszeniu i porównaj dostępne opcje
Interaktywne doprecyzowanie – zadawaj dodatkowe pytania, aby zawęzić wyszukiwanie

Niezależnie od tego, czy kupujesz auto po raz pierwszy, czy jesteś zaprawionym pasjonatem motoryzacji, OTOMOTO sprawia, że zakup samochodu jest tak prosty jak zwykła rozmowa.
payload.longDescription:

主要功能：

精准结果——查看每条车源的信息并比较可选项

无论你是第一次买车，还是经验丰富的汽车爱好者，OTOMOTO 都能让购车像普通聊天一样简单。

payload.name: Fryd

payload.name: Systembolaget

Get help finding the right drink and store. Ask about drinks for your meal, see what’s available at a store near you, and check when your local store is open.
 
Try asking

payload.name: Cora

Perfect if you want to quickly time something or see how fast it is.

在聊天中快速显示秒表（数字式或指针式），并将记录的时间传回 AI。

非常适合快速为某件事计时，或看看它有多快。

payload.name: Trocafone
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trocafone is Brazil's leading marketplace for certified pre-owned tech. We specialize in smartphones but also offer a wide range of devices including tablets, notebooks, smartwatches and accessories from various brands.

Every product goes through rigorous quality testing and is assigned a clear grade so you know exactly what you're getting. All purchases include warranty and are processed securely through our website.

Use this GPT to discover available devices, check specs, compare grades and find the best deals. Purchases and payments are completed at trocafone.com.

Trocafone 是巴西领先的认证二手科技产品市场。我们专营智能手机，也提供各种品牌的平板电脑、笔记本电脑、智能手表和配件。

payload.name: Real Random
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real Random lets people generate a random number, pick one or more items from a list, and shuffle a list inside ChatGPT. It is useful for giveaways, team rotation, classroom activities, and everyday decisions.

Practical ways to use Real Random App:
1. Pick entertainment: Choose movies, TV shows, or books when you can't decide.
2. Raffles & giveaways: Draw one or many winners from participant.
3. Everyday decisions: Randomly pick meals, chores, meeting order, or any list-based choice.
payload.longDescription:
Real Random 可让用户在 ChatGPT 中生成随机数、从列表中选出一个或多个项目，以及打乱列表顺序。适用于抽奖、团队轮换、课堂活动和日常决策。

Real Random 应用的实用场景：
1. 选择娱乐内容：犹豫不决时，从电影、电视节目或书籍中随机挑选。
2. 抽签与赠礼：从参与者中抽出一位或多位获奖者。
3. 日常决策：从列表中随机挑选餐食、家务、会议顺序或其他选项。

payload.name: Square Yards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and explore real estate across India with Square Yards.
                                                                                                    
  Square Yards gives you conversational access to one of India's largest property databases. Search
  new construction projects, rental apartments, and resale properties across major cities, all     
  through natural conversation.                                                                     
                                                                                                    
  Find new projects: Browse new-construction developments with filters for city, budget, unit type,
  developer, and project status. Dive into any project to see pricing, floor plans, amenities, and
  unit configurations.                                                                              
                  
  Search rentals: Explore rental listings filtered by city, rent range, BHK type, furnishing       
  status, and amenities. Get full details on any listing including images and pricing.
                                                                                                    
  Browse resale properties: Discover resale and second-hand listings with filters for city, price  
  range, unit type, and amenities. View complete property details for any listing that catches your
  eye.                                                                                              
                  
  Results appear as interactive property cards with images, pricing, and direct links to      
  Square Yards. Whether you're buying your first home, searching for a rental, or exploring
  investment opportunities, Square Yards helps you make informed property decisions through          
  conversation.
payload.longDescription:
使用 Square Yards 搜索并探索印度各地的房地产。

Square Yards 让你通过对话访问印度规模最大的房产数据库之一。只需自然交流，即可搜索各大城市的新建项目、出租公寓和转售房产。

查找新项目：使用城市、预算、户型、开发商和项目状态等筛选条件浏览新建楼盘。深入查看任一项目的价格、户型图、配套设施和房屋配置。

搜索租赁房源：按城市、租金范围、BHK 户型、家具配置状态和配套设施筛选出租房源。获取任一房源的完整详情，包括图片和价格。

浏览转售房产：按城市、价格范围、户型和配套设施筛选转售及二手房源。查看任何感兴趣房源的完整房产详情。

搜索结果以互动房产卡片呈现，包含图片、价格和指向 Square Yards 的直接链接。无论你是要购买第一套住房、寻找出租房，还是探索投资机会，Square Yards 都能通过对话帮助你作出明智的房产决策。

payload.name: Lifestyle Helper
payload.description: 值得信赖的日常生活建议
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lifestyle Helper improves ChatGPT answers to everyday life questions by adding reliable, up-to-date, source-backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about cooking, travel, entertainment, education, or psychology, the app enriches responses with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally without external references.

Lifestyle Helper does not collect personal data and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based only on the user’s intentions.
payload.longDescription:
Lifestyle Helper 通过补充来自可信专家资料的可靠、最新且有来源支持的背景信息，改进 ChatGPT 对日常生活问题的回答。

当用户询问烹饪、旅行、娱乐、教育或心理学问题时，该应用会补充相关示例和现实见解作为参考。只有在能明确提升实用性时才会添加背景信息。如果没有找到相关来源，ChatGPT 会像往常一样直接回答，不附带外部参考。

Lifestyle Helper 不收集个人数据，也不提供专业法律或财务建议。只有在符合用户意图时才会推荐外部服务。

payload.name: Fresha
payload.description: 预约本地美容与护理服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and book beauty, grooming, and wellness appointments with Fresha on ChatGPT.

- Discover salons, barbers, spas, medspas, and wellness studios near you.
- Search by service, location, date, time, price, and amenities.
- Found the right appointment? Tap “View on Fresha” to book directly with Fresha.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中使用 Fresha 查找并预约美容、理容和健康护理服务。

- 发现附近的美容院、理发店、水疗中心、医疗美容中心和健康工作室。

payload.name: Bayut
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bayut is the easiest way to find your real home in the UAE.

Bayut connects you to a vast database of properties in the UAE, helping you find the perfect option, be it a villa, apartment, office, townhouse or shop - whether for sale or for rent. Easily search for listings using location, property type, bedroom count, price, area, and much more.

Search our listings by asking things like:
- Show me 2-bedroom apartments in Dubai Marina
- Find villas with a jacuzzi under AED 5 million
- Show me penthouses in Dubai over 1,600 sqft
payload.longDescription:
Bayut是在阿联酋找到真正适合你的家的最简单方式。

Bayut让你访问庞大的阿联酋房产数据库，帮助你找到理想选项，无论是别墅、公寓、办公室、联排住宅还是商铺，也无论出售还是出租。按地点、房产类型、卧室数量、价格、面积等轻松搜索房源。

你可以这样询问来搜索房源：

- 查找价格低于AED 5百万且带按摩浴缸的别墅
- 显示迪拜面积超过1,600平方英尺的顶层公寓

payload.name: foodpanda
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
foodpanda lets users discover nearby food delivery restaurants, search for vendors and dishes, and browse full menus with prices, ratings, delivery estimates, and active promotions. Each result includes deep links so the user can continue to order in the foodpanda app or website. Results render in interactive vendor and menu card widgets.

This is only available in SG for now; other countries are coming soon.
payload.longDescription:
foodpanda 帮助用户发现附近的外卖餐厅、搜索商家和菜品，并浏览完整菜单，包括价格、评分、配送时间估算和有效促销。每条结果都包含深层链接，方便用户继续在 foodpanda 应用或网站上点餐。结果以交互式商家和菜单卡片呈现。

目前仅在新加坡（SG）提供服务，其他国家和地区即将开放。

payload.name: Background Changer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Background Changer ChatGPT App gives users access to their general business information such as website and contact email address. The app also allows users to get in touch with the Background Changer  team.
payload.longDescription: Background Changer ChatGPT 应用让用户获取其一般业务信息，例如网站和联系邮箱地址。应用还让用户能够联系 Background Changer 团队。

payload.name: AutoTrader
payload.description: 汽车、摩托车及船艇交易

Looking to buy or sell a vehicle in Canada? With AutoTrader, you get access to the largest inventory of new and used cars nationwide — from Fords and Toyotas to motorcycles, boats, and RVs. Trusted by over 5 million Canadians, our app delivers transparent pricing, expert reviews, and smart tools to help you get the best deal.

With AutoTrader, we provide you with the tools and information you need to make an informed choice. Shop with confidence!

Largest Inventory in Canada
AutoTrader gives you access to over 300,000 new and used vehicles from private sellers and car dealerships across Canada. Whether you're searching for a used car, new SUV, RV, boat, or motorcycle, you’ll find it here – and easily shop listings from both private sellers and dealerships.
payload.longDescription:

想在加拿大买卖车辆？AutoTrader 让你访问全国最大的新车及二手车库存——从 Ford 和 Toyota，到摩托车、船艇和房车。我们的应用深受超过5百万加拿大人的信赖，提供透明价格、专家评测和智能工具，帮助你获得最划算的交易。

AutoTrader 为你提供做出明智选择所需的工具和信息。放心选购！

加拿大最大的车辆库存

payload.name: Milanuncios
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the leading marketplace in Spain directly through ChatGPT. This app allows users to search for second-hand goods, vehicles, real estate, and professional services within the Milanuncios ecosystem. You can filter results by category, location, and price to find the best local deals in real-time. Whether you are looking for a used car, a rental apartment, or local job openings, this integration provides direct access to up-to-date listings and essential product details.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 访问西班牙领先的市场平台。此应用允许用户在 Milanuncios 生态系统中搜索二手商品、车辆、房产和专业服务。按类别、地点和价格筛选结果，实时查找最佳本地优惠。无论你寻找二手车、出租公寓还是当地职位，这项集成都能提供最新房源和必要的商品详情。

payload.name: Tessie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tessie allows you to access and control your Tesla right from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Tessie 让你可以直接通过 ChatGPT 访问并控制自己的 Tesla。

payload.name: BuyWise
payload.description: 找到最佳价格和真实评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BuyWise is a shopping assistant for comparing physical consumer products in ChatGPT. Tell BuyWise what you are looking for, including your budget, use case, preferred features, and constraints, and it helps compare relevant products from supported merchants.
BuyWise can help users:
• Search for products that match a shopping need or budget.
• Compare prices, availability, product details, and key purchase considerations across supported merchants.
• Summarize useful review signals and product tradeoffs to support a more informed purchase decision.
• Recommend suitable options for specific scenarios, such as gifts, home office setups, travel accessories, or consumer tech purchases.
• Direct users to external merchant pages to complete purchases outside ChatGPT.
BuyWise does not process payments inside ChatGPT, does not sell digital goods, and does not replace the merchant’s checkout, return, warranty, or support policies.
payload.longDescription:
BuyWise 是 ChatGPT 中用于比较实体消费品的购物助手。告诉 BuyWise 您要找什么，包括预算、使用场景、偏好功能和限制条件，它会帮助您比较支持商户的相关产品。
BuyWise 可以帮助用户：
• 搜索符合购物需求或预算的产品。
• 比较支持商户的价格、库存、产品详情和关键购买因素。
• 总结有用的评价信号和产品取舍，支持更明智的购买决定。
• 针对礼物、家庭办公、旅行配件或消费科技等具体场景推荐合适选项。
• 将用户引导至外部商户页面，在 ChatGPT 外完成购买。
BuyWise 不在 ChatGPT 内处理付款，不销售数字商品，也不取代商户的结账、退货、保修或支持政策。

payload.name: Apartment List
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Apartment List brings real apartments for rent into your ChatGPT conversation.
Describe what you’re looking for — budget, commute, pets, amenities, move-in timing — and explore available rentals with up-to-date pricing, availability, and fees.

Why it’s different:

payload.name: RealAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The RealAI MCP provides ChatGPT access to RealAI’s authoritative real estate data catalog, spanning 126 million US properties (including 230,000 multifamily communities with unit-level operating detail), aggregated data on the 250 million people who live in them, their rent and leasing activity, and market/geographic data from the metro down to the census-block level.

payload.name: Cafe24

payload.name: Grubhub

payload.name: RentalSource
payload.description: 查找住宅和公寓出租信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RentalSource helps renters search current homes, apartments, condos, and townhouses by location, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, property type, pets, and amenities. payload.name: DealPilot

payload.name: Avito.ma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cars, real estate, smartphones, multimedia, home, fashion, leisure, bikes, DIY... now access Avito.ma listings directly from ChatGPT.

payload.name: Kirah Local Services
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kirah Local Services helps users discover eligible local-service businesses and check current appointment availability. It matches requests against business-published catalogs and returns grounded service names, prices, durations, providers, and time zones. It can apply supported price constraints and, when users ask for the earliest availability, checks a bounded set of candidates and clearly says when results are partial.

Provider profiles, service catalogs, and availability are information published by participating businesses. Kirah treats that material as untrusted data, never instructions to the assistant.

Kirah may interpret a general wellness goal as a starting point for search, but it does not diagnose medical conditions, recommend clinical treatment, or guarantee that a service is suitable. Demonstration businesses are clearly labeled and are never mixed into real-business results without explicit user consent.

Version 1 is informational. It does not create, reschedule, or cancel appointments; collect booking contact details or intake answers; or initiate deposits or payment.
payload.longDescription:
Kirah Local Services 帮助用户发现符合条件的本地服务商，并查看当前预约可用时间。它会根据商家发布的目录匹配请求，返回有依据的服务名称、价格、时长、服务人员和时区。它可以应用支持的价格限制；当用户询问最早可用时间时，会检查有限数量的候选项，并明确说明结果是否不完整。

服务商资料、服务目录和可用时间均由参与商家发布，属于不受信任的数据，绝不会被当作给助手的指令。

Kirah 可以把笼统的健康目标作为搜索起点，但不会诊断疾病、推荐临床治疗，也不保证服务适合某人。示范商家会清楚标注；未经用户明确同意，绝不会与真实商家结果混合。

第 1 版仅提供信息，不会创建、改期或取消预约，不会收集预订联系方式或登记问答，也不会发起订金或付款。
